newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and they are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said rates moved in a narrow range today due to a balance of supply and demand, with the impact of an interest rate cut by the central bank late last month beginning to fade.

"Banks and financial institutions have sufficient short-term money supply," said one trader. "But the interest rate cut has increased returns for mid- and long-term treasury bonds and banks and financial institutions would like to put aside reserves for bond trading."
In addition, recent active domestic stock markets, with a large number of new share issues, have attracted much liquidity from the interbank market, traders said.
